description: Call this tool to draw many barcodes or QR codes at once from a list of rows, each with its own value and file name. Every row comes back as its own download link valid for one hour. Pro; the free tier does one code per call.

height.description: Bar height in the same units (default 80)

filename.description: File name without an extension. Defaults to the value, made safe

module_width.description: Width of the narrowest bar, in pixels or SVG units (default 2)

out_dir.description: Ignored on this hosted endpoint: there are no directories, and every row comes back as its own download link

out_path.description: Name for the downloaded file, e.g. acme-code. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; a PNG always comes back as a download link valid for one hour

overwrite.description: Replace a file of the same name already produced in this request (default false)

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first bad row instead of drawing the rest and reporting it (default false)

symbology.description: Default symbology for rows that do not name one (default code128)

text.description: Print the digits under the bars (default true)

name: barcode_batch
title: Barcodes in bulk
